packages.name: tmux
packages.description: Complete Omarchy-based tmux configuration and private session starter

Run omarchy refresh tmux after removal to restore the Omarchy baseline

packages.name: starship
validators: bash -c 'work=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dotfiles-starship-validator.XXXXXX") || exit 1; diagnostics=$work/stderr; cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$work"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; trap "exit 1" HUP INT TERM; export STARSHIP_CONFIG=$HOME/.config/starship.toml; export STARSHIP_CACHE=$work/cache; export STARSHIP_SESSION_KEY=dotfiles-starship-validation; mkdir -p -- "$STARSHIP_CACHE" || exit 1; if ! starship print-config >/dev/null 2>"$diagnostics"; then cat -- "$diagnostics" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [[ -s $diagnostics ]]; then cat -- "$diagnostics" >&2; exit 1; fi'

packages.name: btop
packages.description: Complete Omarchy-based btop configuration for this machine's ACPI THRM CPU sensor (thermal1/acpitz)
validators: bash -c 'config=$HOME/.config/btop/btop.conf; [[ -r $config ]] || { printf "Error: btop config is not readable: %s\n" "$config" >&2; exit 1; }; required=("#? Config file for btop v.1.4.7" "color_theme = \"current\"" "disable_presets = \"Off\"" "vim_keys = true" "disable_mouse = false" "shown_boxes = \"cpu mem net proc\"" "proc_follow_detailed = true" "cpu_sensor = \"thermal1/acpitz\"" "swap_upload_download = false" "save_config_on_exit = true" "shown_gpus = \"nvidia amd intel\""); for line in "${required[@]}"; do grep -Fqx -- "$line" "$config" || { printf "Error: btop config is missing required line: %s\n" "$line" >&2; exit 1; }; done'

bash -c 'zone=/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone1; for file in device/path type temp; do [[ -r $zone/$file ]] || { printf "Error: btop CPU sensor thermal1/acpitz is incompatible with this hardware: %s is not readable
" "$zone/$file" >&2; exit 1; }; done; IFS= read -r identity < "$zone/device/path"; IFS= read -r type < "$zone/type"; IFS= read -r temp < "$zone/temp"; [[ $identity == "\_TZ_.THRM" ]] || { printf "Error: btop CPU sensor thermal1/acpitz requires ACPI THRM at thermal_zone1; found %s
" "$identity" >&2; exit 1; }; [[ $type == acpitz ]] || { printf "Error: btop CPU sensor thermal1/acpitz requires type acpitz at thermal_zone1; found %s
" "$type" >&2; exit 1; }; [[ $temp =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]] || { printf "Error: btop CPU sensor thermal1/acpitz returned an unreadable temperature: %s
" "$temp" >&2; exit 1; }'
cleanup: Removing this package leaves ~/.config/btop/btop.conf absent
